description: Golden cases for adaptive question generation. Synthetic context only; never real employer or candidate data.

cases.evidence_summary: Led a 3-person team through a sprint; resolved a teammate conflict.

expect.must_not_duplicate: Tell me about how you work with a team

cases.evidence_summary: Wrote SQL queries with joins and indexes; optimized a slow query 10x.
cases.history: Q1 (medium): What indexes did you create? A: A composite index on (user_id, created_at).
